India Debates E20 Fuel Impact Amidst Driver Concerns and Official Defenses

Concerns are mounting in India over the E20 fuel blend, with many drivers reporting reduced mileage and potential vehicle damage. Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal has written to 29 car manufacturers seeking written assurances about the fuel's impact. Meanwhile, Union Minister Nitin Gadkari and other officials are defending the policy, stating there is no evidence of vehicle damage and suggesting attempts to malign the initiative.
